verdict: Leads up, cost per lead down — but Google spend needs fixing now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 134 leads at a $16.48 cost per lead, entirely from Meta, where the best-performing campaign alone accounted for $561 in spend at strong efficiency. The past 7 days showed positive movement: leads up 12.5% and cost per lead down 1.76% week-over-week. The immediate concern is Google Ads, which spent $532 this period with zero recorded conversions — conversion tracking is being repaired so that budget starts working. Once that fix is confirmed, Google will be positioned to scale alongside Meta through the end of October.
